statements.statement: The member has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The member has a diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The member presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are intermittent and must be correlated with possible arrhythmic events
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring) was billed
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered
